description: The figure presents three pie charts comparing the distribution of four categorical outcomes for the “Zero-Shot” setting across difficulty levels labeled easy, medium, and hard, with 4 slices in each pie. In the easy chart, the slices are N+K+ (teal) at about 55.4%, N−K+ (yellow) at about 38.3%, N−K− (orange) at about 4.6%, and N+K− (red) at about 1.7%, with percentage labels shown inside the slices. In the medium chart, N+K+ (teal) is about 58.8%, N−K+ (yellow) about 35.4%, N−K− (orange) about 4.0%, and N+K− (red) about 1.8%, again with internal percentage labels. In the hard chart, N−K− (orange) is about 37.9%, N−K+ (yellow) about 37.3%, N+K+ (teal) about 18.1%, and N+K− (red) about 6.7%, with percentages labeled inside. A legend on the right maps colors to the four labels (N+K+, N−K+, N−K−, N+K−), and none of the slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the slice ordering around each pie appears consistent but not explicitly sorted by size.
